body:
Backfilled Apple for work already merged to origin/main (cloud continuation, session sess-20260925-claude-95f8453d, commit 11f5933 via PR #1). Verified for real: fast-forwarded local to fd9d2e0, ran scripts/build.sh clean -- test_cannon_hold (8 checks) and dw2_cannon_demo both pass, CI green (run 36132295774). dw2_ship_tick's weapon-fire check is now a real, compiled LO program (cannon/cannon_decision.llll -> .prn -> PARENA-generated C, core/cannon.{h,c}), packing the round-break 'behind' signal + shot lethality into LO's real base4 state space. Shipped decision is FIRE in all 4 states (byte-identical to the rule it replaces -- every existing smoke test unchanged); a second standalone program (cannon_bank_on_safe_lead.llll) proves real conditional strategy is expressible, with an honest named failure mode (could stall forever against an unarmed opponent, no compensating payoff for holding fire in this V0). Real finding: LO's own already-named stdlib gaps (matrices, PCRE) turned out unrelated to this feature -- zero new LO stdlib work needed, closing that half of SECTION 549. Doc: DEADWEIGHT_2/docs/LO_CANNON_PROGRAMMING.md (not yet registered in golden-docs-index.md -- fixing in this same pass).

⚓ ☃
